 The Salesforce Enterprise Security Engineering team builds and operates highly scalable, fault\-tolerant, distributed systems that deliver cloud\-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) services across our enterprise network, public cloud infrastructure, and internal data centers. We provide the core building blocks for identity lifecycle, governance, authentication, authorization, and Privileged Access Management (PAM) that protect customer trust and empower every Salesforce engineer to operate securely, regardless of environment.
   

  

 We are hiring (2\) Software Engineers (MTS) across two teams within Enterprise Security IAM, each with a distinct focus:
   

  

* IAM Platform: Design and build the foundational IAM platform — spanning identity lifecycle (human and non\-human), access requests, entitlement and role management, access certifications, PAM capabilities, and policy\-driven access decisions at enterprise scale. You will advance Salesforce's Zero Trust architecture and secure the emerging agentic enterprise, working at the intersection of AI and security engineering.
* Full\-Stack IAM Engineering: Design and build end\-to\-end IAM capabilities — from backend services and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) to the user\-facing experiences that power access requests, entitlement management, and real\-time, dynamic access decisions at scale. You will also play a key role in securing the emerging agentic enterprise by designing controls for AI agents and autonomous workloads.


 Both roles are hands\-on, impact\-driven, and sit at the forefront of how Salesforce secures its enterprise — with AI as a core part of how we build and operate.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
   

  

* Design, build, and operate scalable IAM services and APIs spanning identity lifecycle, access requests, entitlement and role management, and access certifications.

* Model and secure non\-human identities (NHI) — service accounts, agents, workloads, and machine credentials — including issuance, rotation, and lifecycle governance.

* Partner with governance and compliance teams to embed Separation of Duties (SoD), least\-privilege, and audit controls (SOX, NIST, SOC 2\) into the platform.
* Write clean, maintainable, secure code; participate in design and code reviews; and champion secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across security, infrastructure, product, and engineering to ensure platform integrity and trustworthiness.
